'''Berth Two''' was a dock on the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Blood Nest]]. The pirates ordered the [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']] to dock there when the [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]-aligned ship visited the system.<ref name="WS" />
